# Copilot Instructions

The canonical agent instructions for this repository live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Read that file first; it covers the environment, commands, registry architecture, and conventions.

Scoped coding rules (Python core, documentation, testing, machine learning, medicinal chemistry, cheminformatics, experimental biology, security hygiene on the serialization surface, and this project's own registry and testing conventions) are committed under `.claude/rules/`, each with `paths` frontmatter describing the files it applies to. Before editing files a rule matches, read that rule.
